newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK MIXED ON HARD UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK MIXED ON HARD UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted mixed against hard currencies after Friday's quiet interbank trading session, dealers said.

"There was a little bit of a see-saw in the market today. Some banks were buying in the morning and the (exchange) rates went up but they (banks) came down to everyone else's levels towards the end," one dealer said.
He said the dollar hit the 10.7600/7800 level against the U.S. dollar on the back of slight import pressure before settling back to close at its overnight 10.7550/7750.
However, it closed weaker against pound sterling at 18.0800/1000 compared to 18.0500/0700, tracking a softer U.S. dollar abroad, but edged up on the mark to 7.0000/0200 from 7.0200/0400.
Against South Africa's rand, the Zimbabwe dollar finished the day firmer at 2.3300/3500 compared to 2.3400/3600 on Thursday.
